messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Text: Cyclobenzaprine is a prescription muscle relaxant.
It is used short-term to relieve muscle spasms.
The spasms are caused by sprains, strains, and injuries.
These include low back and neck pain.
It is used together with rest and physical therapy.
This combination helps relieve pain, tenderness, and limited movement.
These symptoms are caused by muscle spasm.
1,2
Cyclobenzaprine is used to treat fibromyalgia in adults.
It can help reduce pain.
For fibromyalgia, it is taken as a sublingual (under the tongue) tablet at bedtime under the brand name Tonmya.
In clinical trials, Tonmya significantly reduced fibromyalgia pain compared with placebo over 14 weeks.
Close to half of treated patients achieved at least a 30% improvement in pain.
3
The Flexeril brand has been discontinued.
Cyclobenzaprine is available as generic tablets.
Cyclobenzaprine is also available as the brand-name products Amrix and Fexmid.

The relation 'caused by' in the triplet is defined as 'The object entity is a cause or contributing factor to the condition or event specified by the subject entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

A. 'is defined as': The subject condition or entity is defined by the description specified by the object entity.
B. 'contribute to': The subject entity plays a role in or contributes to the development or occurrence of the object entity, which is typically a physiological or pathological process.
C. 'can lead to': The subject condition or event may result in the medical complication or outcome specified by the object entity.
